_what: A send that waits a short while so the person can take it back (src/held-sends.mjs): an email, a message to an audience, a share, anything a Marketplace tool or workflow sends. `then` is what runs, exactly as set_schedule names it ({ tool_id, input } or { workflow_id, input }); it is run by the person's own schedules at send time, so a held send is retried, shown and recorded like any schedule. `undo_seconds` is how long it waits; `default_undo_seconds` when the caller gives none and `least_undo_seconds`/`most_undo_seconds` bound it. A held send's schedule id begins with `schedule_prefix`, followed by the token; the token is the cancel handle. `words` are every sentence the person or their AI reads.

states.held: Waiting; it can still be taken back until {until}.
states.cancelled: It was taken back and was never sent.

words.held: Held. It goes out at {until}; take it back before then with cancel_held_send.
words.cancelled: Taken back. It was never sent.
words.too_late: It already went out at {at}, so it cannot be taken back.
words.unknown: There is no held send {token}. list_held_sends shows the ones waiting or recently sent.
words.bad_then: Name what to send: then is { tool_id, input } or { workflow_id, input }.
words.bad_seconds: undo_seconds is a whole number from {least} to {most}.
